title: What movies do you consider the perfect example of their genre?

commenti.body:
The Good, the Bad and the Ugly is the perfect Spaghetti Western

Harakiri is the perfect Samurai film

Lawrence of Arabia is the perfect historical epic

Amadeus is the perfect historical drama

Hot Fuzz is the perfect Buddy Comedy (SotD is also acceptable)

The Princess Bride is the perfect fantasy/adventure

Calling pulp fiction “crime action” feels a bit off to me. Tarantino makes his own type of “pulpy” films- meaning incorporating several genres, I believe. Crime action to me would probably be … transporter 2 or some shit. 

Horror - the exorcist 

Comedy - happy Gilmore

Drama - the godfather

Sci fi/Action = terminator 2 

Adventure - Indiana jones

Action = mad max fury road 

Horror comedy = evil dead 2

Horror action = predator 

Mystery = the conversation 

Thriller horror = silence of the lambs 

Historical = Lincoln

>Calling pulp fiction “crime action” feels a bit off to me. Tarantino makes his own type of “pulpy” films- meaning incorporating several genres, I believe. Crime action to me would probably be … transporter 2 or some shit.

Yeah, I had trouble with coming up with an accurate, specific genre - I wanted to come up with something almost comic book-y tbh, but I mostly just was looking for a couple quick examples for the OP. kinda looks like they struck a nerve with a couple people judging by all the downvotes lol.

Thanks for the post, you picked a lot of great & accurate examples.

Songs From the Second Floor is the perfect hilariously depressing tableaux of materialistic religious parody featuring ghosts.

Prospero’s Books is the perfect metafictional adaptation showing the act of adapting a work of metafiction in the form of an opera

Le quattro volte is the perfect documentary in the form of a fictional story in the form of a documentary

Since genres are terrible, I ignored existing genres and picked films that seemed to exist in the form that best matches the reason for the existence of the film, which can likely not be duplicated, unlike genre films, which is essentially why they are terrible. Fun, sure, but terrible. As for essential genre tropes, the more there are the worse the films will be.
